rule: The crops are 32x512x512, capped by the test region. They tile the bounding box of the annotation without overlap and stay clear of tuning data. Crops with fewer than 20% of the median object count of the dataset are left out. 2d sets without an entry are scored on the 512x512 center crop. The note of a dataset gives its exceptions.

gonuclear.note: The crops leave out the layer at z=8. Its 3 crops hold 10-19 nuclei, the other crops 111-347.

embedseg_platy_nuclei.note: The annotation covers z 18-100 in a 382x394 region. The volume around it is empty.

celegans_atlas.note: The crops span the full height of the worm cross-section (140 px) and tile the annotated length.

nis3d.note: The crops avoid the tuning slab at z 158-198.

embedseg_mouse_skull.note: The crops avoid the tuning slab at z 100-125.

embedseg_platy_ish.note: The crops avoid the tuning slab at z 0-21.

wing_disc.note: The crops avoid the tuning slab at z 0-12. The cells span the whole stack.

snemi.note: The test region is 20 slices deep.

humanneurons.note: The crops avoid the tuning slab at z 0-16.

platynereis_cells.note: The crops tile the test region of volume 9. The neuropil carries the ignore label and is not scored.

lucchi.note: The annotation covers x 49-1024 of the whole test volume. The tiles at the volume edge are capped. The crops leave out the last 5 slices and 2 crops with 1 mitochondrion each, the other crops hold 2-15.

mitolab_c_elegans.note: Mitochondria panel: the crops tile the annotation inside the test region (the tuning slab at the start of the stack is left out). The test region is z 48-256 of the 256^3 volume.

Tiles thinner than 16 slices or 256 px in plane, tiles with a blank section and tiles where more than half of the voxels are padding (-1, the area around the rotated section, excluded from scoring) are dropped, and of the tiles that pass the object-count rule at most 16 are kept, the ones with the most objects. 16 of 25 tiles are kept, holding 5-18 mitochondria, with 0-49% padding.

The ground truth is the authors' automated deep-learning segmentation (semantic, made instances by connected components). 12 of 12 tiles are kept, holding 13-25 mitochondria.

fafb_nuclei.note: Nucleus panel: the four official FAFB test blocks (automatic FlyWire nucleus segmentation). 27 of 32 tiles are kept (at most 16 per volume, the ones with the most objects), holding 15-55 nuclei.

microns_nuclei.note: Nucleus panel: the four official MICrONS test blocks (automatic minnie65 nucleus segmentation). 63 of 64 tiles are kept (at most 16 per volume, the ones with the most objects), holding 1-9 nuclei.

platynereis_nuclei.note: Nucleus panel: Platynereis volume 03 inside its annotated box (manual instances). 3 of 3 tiles are kept (at most 16 per volume, the ones with the most objects), holding 51-57 nuclei.

human_liver_em_nucleus.note: Nucleus panel (out-of-domain): three 4x downsampled human liver boxes (automated segmentation, every visible nucleus labeled). 9 of 12 tiles are kept (at most 16 per volume, the ones with the most objects), holding 1-3 nuclei.

parlakgul_liver_eval.note: Mitochondria panel (out-of-domain): the manual Parlakgul evaluation crops are only 25 x 150 x 150, so each scored crop (the first two per liver sample) is one fixed crop of the whole volume (capped to the crop).

cerebellum_fibsem_mito.note: Mitochondria panel (out-of-domain): the Cerebellum FIB-SEM volume below the tuning slab (the first 106 slices); student-labeled mitochondria instances, not necessarily proofread. 16 of 52 tiles are kept (at most 16 per volume, the ones with the most objects), holding 14-22 mitochondria.

mito_anf.note: Mitochondria panel (out-of-domain): the two MitoANF boxes below their tuning slabs (the first 26 slices); only the mitochondria of traced auditory nerve fibers are labeled (about half of the visible ones). 24 of 24 tiles are kept (at most 16 per volume, the ones with the most objects), holding 6-58 mitochondria.

macrophage_a431_mito.note: Mitochondria panel (out-of-domain): the Macrophage / A431 fib_control block (z 848-975) below the tuning slab (the first 26 slices); quick semantic MIB mitochondria labels, made instances by connected components. 16 of 66 tiles are kept (at most 16 per volume, the ones with the most objects), holding 5-14 mitochondria.

snemi_mito.note: 15 x 512 x 512 tiles of the test split (30 x 1024 x 1024): its z is split in two for more crops. 8 crops, holding 11-16 objects.

donglai_wei_mito.note: Mitochondria panel (out-of-domain): internal data from Donglai Wei (not public), the MICrONS phase 1 volume below the tuning slab (the first 150 slices). The labels are dense in the crops (checked by eye). 16 of 1216 tiles are kept (at most 16 per volume, the ones with the most objects), holding 46-54 mitochondria.

etchacell_nucleus.note: Nucleus panel (out-of-domain): the scored Etch a Cell ROIs (HeLa SBF-SEM, 4x downsampled in-plane, one nucleus per ROI, filled from the consensus nuclear envelope labels). 96 of 117 tiles are kept (at most 16 per volume, the ones with the most objects), holding 1-2 nuclei.

nucmm_zebrafish.note: Nucleus panel (out-of-domain): the scored NucMM-Z volumes (ssEM at about 0.5 um, 64^3), each crop a whole volume; manual instances. 4 of 5 tiles are kept (at most 16 per volume, the ones with the most objects), holding 56-612 nuclei.

nucmm_mouse.note: Nucleus panel (out-of-domain): the four NucMM-M val volumes (X-ray micro-CT at 0.72 um, 192^3, not EM); manual instances. 20 of 24 tiles are kept (at most 16 per volume, the ones with the most objects), holding 8-70 nuclei.

aive_nucleus.note: Nucleus panel (out-of-domain): AIVE datasets 2 and 3 below the tuning slab (the first 40 slices), one nucleus per volume with the nucleoli folded in. 25 of 26 tiles are kept (at most 16 per volume, the ones with the most objects), holding 1-1 nuclei.

elmi_mito.note: 512 x 512 tiles of the test images that hold a labeled mitochondrion; only 3-5 are labeled per image. 16 crops, holding 1-2 objects.
